OFFLINE NATIVE SOURCES: RETURNED HISTORY, EARLY DIPLOMACY, MODERN AGREEMENTS

Source images are data/runtime/native-pe-images.json's configured files:
reference D:/program/steam/steamapps/common/Dwarf Fortress/Dwarf Fortress.exe
SHA256 205770918fd54c96cbbcf89223ebd449e2e113c7c873ed81177c4511a3450db7
classic C:/Users/WIN11/Downloads/df_53_16_win/Dwarf Fortress.exe
SHA256 f35bbaf37aa96f93f95f8a35a9341e6649da46bc29a8650316bfdc2dfc57f3e4

This file reconstructs the assembly and PE operands retained alongside it.
It is extraction source data. It does not describe observed game output.
Function ends from .pdata may include jump tables after the executable RET.

1. STATIC BOUNDARY OF A RETURNED TRAVELLER'S HISTORY PARAGRAPH

The three traveller return arms call history_event virtual slot +0xd0.
Reference call sites: 10dbcf, 10dd76..10dd99, 10df99..10dfbc.
Classic call sites have the corresponding -0x70 displacement.
They pass the existing native context, r9b=1, fifth argument=0 and append a
nonempty result after a double-space separator, then publish announcement 301.

Reference 10d807 selects pending returning army records. Each record's +0x58
squad_mission ID is looked up by 72570. mission+0x128 is a vector of units.
Reference 10d8f9 examines each unit's +0x404 array of 64 signed int32 event IDs.
IDs below 1 are ignored. Different positive IDs set the common value to -2,
which suppresses the event body. A common positive ID is retained at 10d941.
Reference 10db91 rejects the absent -1 value. 7da30 looks up that event in
global 24f9cb8; the caller does not ask its type before calling vtable+0xd0.

Therefore the static formatter boundary is all 133 concrete native history
event classes numbered 0..132, not only diplomatic classes. This does not
assert every class is generated into those unit slots by simulation logic.
The positive-ID, common-ID, lookup and nonempty-text conditions still apply.

returned-history-dispatch.tsv records 133 actual d0 pointer reads per image,
their RTTI class, vtable RVA, function owner and .pdata end (266 total roots).
reference/classic-returned-event-sentences.asm retain all those root bodies.
returned-history-literals.tsv records their actual PE string references.
returned-history-call-edges.tsv records direct/import call operands from the
retained disassembly; instructions rendered from trailing table data are not
additional executable branches. The existing full helper closure remains in
data/extracted/mission-report-sources.tsv: 133 sentence roots, 133 subjects,
18 collection roots and recursively discovered shared formatter functions,
470 unique owners. See mission-report-source-notes.md for its typed boundary.

2. EARLY DIPLOMACY IS DISTINCT FROM MODERN AGREEMENT_FORMED

Reference / classic d0 entries:
6  first_contact            b81170 / b7e1b0
7  first_contact_failed     b814d0 / b7e510
8  topicagreement_concluded b81830 / b7e870
9  topicagreement_rejected  b81b60 / b7eba0
10 topicagreement_made      b82720 / b7f760
11 war_peace_accepted       b83650 / b80690
12 war_peace_rejected       b839b0 / b809f0

All start with "In " + date(b92640/b8f680) + ", ". Entity names use
b92900/b8f940. Optional event site names use b93930/b90970. Their bodies:
6  ENTITY(source) + " made contact with " + ENTITY(destination)
7  ENTITY(destination) + " rejected contact with " + ENTITY(source)
9  TOPIC + " proposed by " + ENTITY(source) + " was rejected by " + ENTITY(destination)
10 if topic==13:
       TOPIC + " was made to " + ENTITY(destination) + " by " + ENTITY(source)
   else:
       TOPIC + " proposed by " + ENTITY(source) + " was accepted by " + ENTITY(destination)
11 ENTITY(destination) + " accepted an offer of peace from " + ENTITY(source)
12 ENTITY(destination) + " rejected an offer of peace from " + ENTITY(source)
For these six types, an optional " at " + SITE precedes the terminal ".".
If event detail is available through the native flag-4 path, detail+0x08 is
negotiation and detail+0x10 is intrigue. Each formatter's nonempty capitalized
paragraph is appended after two spaces, negotiation first, intrigue second.

8 TOPIC + " between " + ENTITY(source) + " and " + ENTITY(destination)
  + optional(" at " + SITE) + " concluded" + OUTCOME + "."
  It has no negotiation or intrigue tail.
  magnitude -3: " with miserable outcome"
            -2: " in failure"
            -1: " in an unsatisfactory fashion"
             0: " fairly"
             1: " with a positive outcome"
             2: ", cementing bonds of mutual trust"
       default: ""

TOPIC helper is leaf b95020..b95170 / b92060..b921b0. The signed int16 topic
selects a 17-entry table at b9512c / b9216c; the executable leaf ends in tail
jumps, not a .pdata owner. meeting-topic assembly and helper literal files
retain its actual RIP-relative literal operands rather than omitting it.
1 "a peace agreement"; 2 "a lumber agreement";
3 "the establishment of landed nobility";
4 "the elevation of the landed nobility";
5/6 "a trade agreement"; 9 "a tribute agreement";
10 "a demand of unconditional surrender"; 13 "a declaration of war";
14 "an alliance"; 15/16 "a strengthening of trade ties";
0/7/8/11/12 and every out-of-range value: "a vague agreement".
The screenshot's strengthening-of-trade-ties sentence belongs to this path.

3. MODERN AGREEMENT_FORMED: COMPLETE EIGHTEEN-WAY DISPATCH

Sentence d0 reference 2aaf70..2ad7eb, classic 2a8b30..2ab3ab.
Subject d8 reference 2ad7f0..2afec3, classic 2ab3b0..2ada83.
Paired assembly, agreement-native-literals.tsv and agreement-native-switches.tsv
retain both functions and all finite selector/remap operands independently.
Reference tables: d0 main 2ad70c, crime 2ad754, joining remap 2ad7c0/table 2ad7a0;
                  d8 main 2afde4, crime 2afe2c, joining remap 2afe98/table 2afe78.
Joining raw selector table has 43 entries 0..42 and eight normalized targets.

agreement *a = lookup(global 24e7e98, event.agreement_id);
if (!a || a.parties.empty() || a.elements.empty() || first.type outside 0..17) {
    d0_body = "a corrupt agreement was formed";
    d8_body = "the formation of a corrupt agreement";
} else dispatch a.elements[0]; // first element only

Native lookup narrows a sorted vector until at most 64 entries, then scans.
P(i) below is a party ID in this agreement, not a historical figure ID.
Required P(i) lookup failure emits "an unknown party". Existing party pointers
use e2b80/e2b10: all HF vector members first (b92f10), then all entity members
(b92900), in native list order. A present party with both vectors empty emits
an empty string. It must not be replaced with "an unknown party".
HF(i), E(i), SITE(i) and ART(i) denote distinct native typed formatter calls.
The d0 and d8 grammars retain independent literal word order; d8 ends with
" in " + DATE, while d0 has the date in its opening and a final period.
Native d0 flag context.flags&1 chooses "Subject revealed that in " vs "In ".

case 0 (join; d0 2ace29, d8 2af744):
    d0 P(data[1]) + " joined with " + P(data[2]);
    d8 "the joining of " + P(data[1]) + " with " + P(data[2]);
    purpose data[0]:
      0  " to oust " + optional E(data[4]) + " from " + optional SITE(data[3]);
      1  " to live a life of adventure";
      2  " as a guide"; choose one target in this precedence:
           data[5]!=-1: " to find " + HF(data[5]);
           else data[4]!=-1: " to find " + IDENTITY(data[4], c3a590);
           else data[3]!=-1: " to " + SITE(data[3]);
           else no target suffix;
      23 " in order to be brought to safety";
      24 " to help rescue " + HF(data[5]) if present,
           otherwise IDENTITY(data[4]) if present, otherwise empty target;
      39 d0 " after being compelled to serve", d8 " in bound service";
      42 " to entertain the world";
      default no purpose suffix. Each purpose returns; it does not chain goals.

case 1 (permanent join; d0 2ac96b, d8 2af206):
    d0 P(data[2]) + " aided " + P(data[1])
       + " in becoming a permanent part of the living world";
    shared b5a6c0 reason=data[0], value=data[5] only for cosmic reason 4,
       otherwise -1. Unknown/blank reasons leave the clause blank.
    Independent optional ritual site=data[3], artifact=data[4]:
       site: ". The ritual took place in " + SITE;
       site and artifact: previous + " using " + ART;
       artifact only: ". The ritual involved " + ART;
    d8 "the permanent joining by " + P(data[2]) + " of " + P(data[1])
       + " to the living world";

case 2 (residence; d0 2acbbf, d8 2af4f2):
    d0 P(data[1]) + " made an agreement with " + P(data[2]);
    optional ", becoming a resident of " + SITE(data[3]);
    purpose 41 " to eradicate monsters", 42 " to entertain the citizenry",
       43 " to work as a mercenary", 44 " to study", default empty;
    d8 "the agreement between " + P(data[1]) + " and " + P(data[2])
       + purpose first + optional(" and become a resident of " + SITE(data[3]));
case 3 (citizenship; d0 2acd27, d8 2af630):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " made an agreement with " + P(data[1])
       + optional(", becoming a citizen of " + SITE(data[2]));
    d8 "the agreement between " + P(data[0]) + " and " + P(data[1])
       + optional(" and become a citizen of " + SITE(data[2]));
case 4 (parley; d0 2acaf2, d8 2af3ad):
    d0 P(data[1]) + " agreed to a parley with " + P(data[2]);
    d8 "the parley between " + P(data[1]) + " and " + P(data[2]);

case 5 (corruption; d0 2ac724, d8 2aeec6):
    d0 P(data[1]) + " began "; action data[0]:
       247 "accepting bribes in exchange for leniency";
       248 "embezzling funds";
       249 "passing a portion of corruptly-obtained funds";
       default empty action, retaining party, began and every following arm;
    d8 action 247 "the bribery of", 248 "the embezzlement of",
       249 "the passing of corruptly-obtained funds by ", default empty;
       + P(data[1]); the first two native prefixes have no trailing space.
    action!=249 and a resolved position: " as a " / " as the " + OFFICE
       + " of " + E(data[4]); unique flag int16==1 chooses "the".
       A resolved position with an empty title keeps the office/owner arm.
    action==249 and recipient P(data[2]) exists: " to " + recipient;
    action!=249 and influence P(data[2]) exists: " under the influence of "+party;
    optional messenger P(data[3]): " via " + party;
    This type always uses under-influence, not the approach form.

case 6 (theft; d0 2ac1d7, d8 2ae859):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " plotted to steal " + ART(data[3]);
    d8 "the plot of " + P(data[0]) + " to steal " + ART(data[3]);
    influence=data[1], messenger=data[2];
case 7 (promise; d0 2ac37b, d8 2aeabc):
    beneficiary=P(data[0]), promiser=P(data[1]), recipient=P(data[2]);
    d0 promiser + " promised " + required recipient;
    d8 "the promise by " + promiser + " to " + required recipient;
    if beneficiary==recipient (including both missing), d0 has no give phrase,
       d8 appends " of";
    else append " to give "; append beneficiary only if its pointer exists;
    append " a position" + optional(" in " + E(union+0x28));
    influence=data[3]; via is complete party-ID vector at union+0x10.
case 8 (assassination; d0 2ac036, d8 2ae5ec):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " plotted to assassinate " + optional HF(data[3]);
    d8 "the plot of " + P(data[0]) + " to assassinate " + optional HF(data[3]);
    influence=data[1], messenger=data[2];
case 9 (abduction; d0 2abe95, d8 2ae37f):
    same party/target/tails as case 8, with "abduct" instead of "assassinate";
case 10 (sabotage; d0 2abc8b, d8 2ae0bc):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " plotted to sabotage the activities of ";
    d8 "the plot of " + P(data[0]) + " to sabotage the activities of ";
    target precedence HF(data[3]), E(data[4]), SITE(data[5]), otherwise empty;
    if HF or E is present, independently append optional(" at " + SITE(data[5]));
    influence=data[1], messenger=data[2];
case 11 (foiled conspiracy; d0 2ab149, d8 2ad98d):
    d0 PARTY_LIST(union+0) + " concocted "; corruption int32 at union+0x18:
       0 "a bribery conspiracy", 2 "a corruption conspiracy",
       3 "a embezzlement conspiracy", default empty noun;
    d8 corresponding "the ... conspiracy", then " concocted by " + PARTY_LIST;
       default keeps the concocted-by connector and complete list.
case 12 (building; d0 2ad0dc, d8 2af9f9):
    d0 P(data[1]) + " agreed to establish ";
    d8 "the agreement by " + P(data[1]) + " to establish ";
    building=data[3], tier=int32 at union+0x1c:
       building2/tier1 "a temple"; building2/tier2 "a temple complex";
       building11/tier1 "a guildhall"; building11/tier2 "a grand guildhall";
       any other combination empty noun;
    then always " for " + P(data[0]);
case 13 (infiltration; d0 2ab30e, d8 2adae0):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " plotted to infiltrate " + optional E(data[2]);
    goals data[3] bits 1/2/4/8 append, in that order:
       "steal treasures", "initiate sabotage", "instill terror", "prepare a coup";
       if any, " in order to " + complete native goal list;
    d8 "the plot of " + P(data[0]) + " to infiltrate " + optional E(data[2]);
    influence=data[1]; d8 has no goals list.
case 14 (frame; d0 2ab746, d8 2adc39):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " plotted to frame " + optional HF(data[2]);
    d8 "the plot of " + P(data[0]) + " to frame " + optional HF(data[2]);
    both + " for " + CRIME(data[4]) + " by fooling " + optional HF(data[3]);
    CRIME selectors 0..18, exact jump-table order:
       production order violation; export prohibition violation; job order violation;
       a conspiracy to slow labor; murder; disorderly conduct; building destruction;
       vandalism; theft; robbery; blood-drinking; embezzlement; attempted murder;
       kidnapping; attempted kidnapping; attempted theft; treason; espionage; bribery.
    out-of-range crime is empty. All three connectors still remain, independent
       of missing figures. Influence=data[1] only when data[1]!=data[0].
case 15 (war; d0 2aba38, d8 2adee4):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " plotted to induce a war of ";
    d8 "the plot of " + P(data[0]) + " to induce a war of ";
    both + optional E(data[2]) + " upon " + optional E(data[3]);
    influence=data[1];
case 16 (service; d0 2ad288, d8 2afb55):
    d0 P(data[0]) + " requested that " + P(data[1]) + " make an offer of service";
    d8 "the request by " + P(data[0]) + " that " + P(data[1]) + same predicate;
    optional " to " + E(data[2]);
case 17 (retrieval; d0 2ad44c, d8 2afc7d):
    d0 P(data[1]) + " asked that " + P(data[0]) + " retrieve " + ART(data[2]);
    d8 "the request by " + P(data[1]) + " that " + P(data[0]) + same predicate;
    optional " from " + E(data[3]); independently optional " for " + E(data[4]);
    Both operands call ENTITY formatter b92900, not a site or party formatter.

Plot influence pointer present:
    d0 uses agreement_flags&1 to choose
       " approached by " + PARTY + " to handle the matter directly or through another party"
       vs " under the influence of " + PARTY;
    d8 retains " under the influence of " + PARTY.
Optional messenger tails use " via " + PARTY or the entire promise messenger list.
d0's optional event support appends negotiation and intrigue independently after
the completed main sentence, in native order, using the same two-space separator.

4. AGREEMENT_CONCLUDED TYPE 77: EMPTY NOUN IS A REAL BRANCH

Reference b81f00..b82714, classic b7ef40..b7f754. Roots are retained in the
returned-event assembly. conclusion-native-switches.tsv independently reads
each image's 18-entry noun switch, 43-entry joining-purpose remap and 40-entry
conclusion-reason remap. d0 short nouns differ from type 75's full d8 subjects.

out = "In " + DATE + ", " + HF(concluder) + " concluded ";
if agreement lookup missing:
    out += "an agreement."; return; // no other party or conclusion reason
if elements nonempty and first.type in 0..17:
    0 goal0 "an insurrection mission", 1 "an adventure", 2 "a guide agreement",
      23 "a journey to safety", 24 "a rescue mission", 39 "bound service",
      42 "a performance tour"; default EMPTY;
    1 EMPTY;
    2 "a residency agreement"; 3 "a citizenship agreement"; 4 "a parley";
    5 "corrupt dealing"; 6 "a theft deal"; 7 "a promise of position";
    8 "an assassination plot"; 9 "an abduction plot"; 10 "a sabotage plot";
    11 corruption0 "a foiled bribery conspiracy",
       2 "a foiled corruption conspiracy", 3 "a foiled embezzlement conspiracy",
       default EMPTY;
    12 building2 "an agreement to establish a temple",
       building11 "an agreement to establish a guildhall", default EMPTY;
       location tier is not consulted by this short noun;
    13 "an infiltration plot"; 14 "a framing plot"; 15 "a war starting plot";
    16 "a request to offer service" + optional(" to " + E(data[2]));
    17 "an agreement to retrieve " + ART(data[2])
       + optional(" for " + E(data[4])); // from entity is omitted here
else retain EMPTY noun;

for party in agreement.parties in native order:
    if concluder not in party.figures:
        out += " with " + PARTY(party); break;
// This still executes for every empty/default noun branch.
conclusion_reason:
    13 "on a whim";
    30/31 "because the group travelled too slowly";
    32/35 "because the group went too far away";
    33/40 "after arriving at the destination";
    34 "because of a leadership change at the site";
    36 "after a joyous reunion";
    37 "after a violent disagreement";
    38 "after an adoption";
    52 "due to a lack of performances";
    every other value EMPTY;
out += ".";

Runtime grammar sources: data/runtime/announcement-event-grammar.tsv and
announcement-negotiation-grammar.tsv. Direct composition mirrors the typed
arguments in src/history_semantics_agreements.inc and history_semantics_diplomacy.inc.
Unknown native selector branches with empty predicates retain their main
sentence, office, participant, influence, messenger and support text.
